version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: This brand manager is mostly coherent, but its script can write outside the intended brand-data folder if a brand name contains path characters.

dimensions.detail: Local file reads and writes are proportionate for a brand knowledge store, and the declared tools are read and exec; however, BRAND_DATA_DIR and unsanitized brand IDs broaden where JSON state can be written.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installation, background service, or install-time mutation is present; the artifact contains SKILL.md and a Python helper script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow discloses create/query/check/switch actions, but the executable derives filenames directly from brand names without rejecting slashes or parent-directory components, so a state-changing brand operation can escape the documented data/brands path.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent writes to data/brands/*.json and active_brand.json are expected and disclosed, but path handling does not reliably confine writes to that directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is coherent: it creates, queries, checks, lists, and switches brand profiles using local JSON records and an optional vector-store concept described in the instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. The skill is not showing hidden exfiltration or destructive intent, but it should validate brand names so profile creation and switching cannot address files outside the intended brand store. Use only trusted brand names and avoid path-like names until that is fixed.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger scope is broad, but the documented examples and script require explicit create/query/check/switch/list commands; the broader concern is not invocation alone but that state-changing commands are not tightly path-scoped.
[SQP-2] expected: Durable local state is part of the stated brand-management purpose and is disclosed in the workflow; this is acceptable in principle, but users should notice that switch changes future active-brand context.
